                            Dear User,
                        </p>
                        <p class="paragraphOfflineText">
                            Please be informed that EMITS was decommissioned on 23rd March 2021 and is no longer accessible to external users:
                        </p>
                        <p class="paragraphOfflineText">
                            its functionalities have been transferred to the new <span style="color: #fff; background-color:#00549f; padding: 5px;">esa-star Publication</span> module.
                        </p>
                        <p class="paragraphspace">
                        </p>
                        <p class="paragraphOfflineText">
                            The <span style="font-style: italic;">esa-star Publication</span> module can be accessed from the new <span style="color: #fff; background-color:#00549f; padding: 5px;">Doing Business with ESA</span> portal, at the following link:
                            <br /><br />
                            <a target="_blank" href="http://doing-business.sso.esa.int">http://doing-business.sso.esa.int</a>
                        </p>
                        <p class="paragraphspace">
                        </p>
                        <p class="paragraphspace">
                        </p>

                            <br />

                            <br />
